english: I hate a drinking companion with a good memory

terms.comment: Martial quotes the saying in Greek, μισῶ μνάμονα συμπόταν, “I hate a fellow drinker with a memory” (1.27.7), to a guest who took a drunken invitation seriously. Traupman’s Latin translates the Greek; we have found no ancient Latin form.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Martial 1.27.7, checked against the Perseus Latin texts (12 November 2026).
